high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from a mobile device. The top part of the screen shows the status bar with various icons indicating the time (11:16), battery level (100%), and connectivity status. There is also a WhatsApp icon on the right side. Below the status bar, there is an advertisement banner for Uttar Pradesh's government, featuring a person in traditional attire and some text in Hindi. The banner includes social media handles and a website link. The main content of the image is a news article about a space mission.
